R02 is shown when a concept shows a person acting for a room toward another room: carrying a proposal, terms, an answer, an apology or news of an agreement between venues in the room's name (CA); named, appointed or self-named diplomat, ambassador, envoy, representative, liaison or delegate, or sent to talk to a room (NA); seated for a room in a shared council, alliance chat or hub (CO). Sides: OE (the room's own member) and VE (a visitor acting for its own room in this room's threads), both read under G18; a visitor speaking only for themself is not an envoy. Not shown: talk of terms with no go-between (P08), a truce reported with no go-between (P08), P21's forms, leaders inside the room (C01, R01, P20), attacks, taunts, help, coalitions or host rules with no go-between. Absent: G2, G3, G6. Restrict: G9. Add-condition: G4a (R02, P08, P21, P17). Census before the status ruling, by form, side and AC; draws by G1b from verb offset 187 (packets 100, 100, 100, 100, 93). (1) A member's report of having carried a proposal to another room, or talked with it, in its venue (its sub, chat or private messages), or a promise to carry it, is CA with OE (2007scape c0489, c1012; 49ers c0041; AMD c0297; AcePlace c0074; AyyMD c0082; DestinyTheGame c0107; Dominican c0068; FederationPlace c0021, c0036; FinalFantasy c0012; FloydVsVoid c0200). Reported talks or an attempt to negotiate with another room count at the range's lower end (4chan c0136; AmericanFlaginPlace c0306). (2) A visitor who speaks for its room (us at r/X, r/X here, from r/X, one of the builders of a named work) and carries a proposal, request, assurance or invitation into this room's thread is CA with VE (AMD c0298; AceOfAngels8 c0020; ChronoTrigger c0023; Cornwall c0002; DatBoi c0041; EraseThePlace c0047; Fez c0084; Goodboye c0006; GreenEmpire c0006). (3) A self-named ambassador, or a proposal to send a delegation, names the role (NA: AprilKnights c0063; GreenCorner c0097; AmericanFlaginPlace c0084). A member approved as a council leader in a shared congress chat sits for the room (CO: AvoArmy c0114). (4) A post that asks, in the speaker's own voice, for a meeting place for the room's flag near a named sign, with no one acting for a room between venues, is a proposal of place (P02, P08), not R02 (NOT: GranColombia-024 c0060). (5) A visitor who reports that the room's own member sits in the visitor's chat shows the room's envoy (OE) beside the visitor's (VE) (FaroeIslands c0046). Next: R02-inst-spec-1.txt
